subject.title: feat: Rust/GTK4 Linux companion app (#75, alternative track)

question: Which Linux companion architecture, if any, should OpenClaw support from PR #61576 before more repair work proceeds?
rationale: The branch is a large new desktop surface with security-sensitive gateway access and overlaps the open C/GTK-native Linux companion candidate in #59859, so automation cannot safely choose the product architecture or security posture.

options.title: Select Rust GTK after repair
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if maintainers want the Rust/GTK4 architecture and require contract repairs, proof, and security review before merge.

options.title: Prefer the current C/GTK track
options.body: Use #59859/#75 as the canonical Linux companion path and close or archive this branch once the contributor has a chance to preserve useful ideas elsewhere.

options.title: Keep as prototype only
options.body: Leave the PR open as exploratory community work until platform direction is settled, without treating it as merge-ready.

recommendation.title: Prefer the current C/GTK track
recommendation.body: Use #59859/#75 as the canonical Linux companion path and close or archive this branch once the contributor has a chance to preserve useful ideas elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is most closely tied to the current Linux/Windows companion product direction and platform-app documentation trail in the available issue and git history.
